QuestInfo.name: Poor Blondie
QuestInfo.0: Blondie, the poor blonde kitty has shed all her fur in this hot weather. There must be something that can be done for the poor little thing...
QuestInfo.2: Blondie is even cuter with her new golden hair, and you have never seen #b#p9270060##k happier for his kitty.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: Able to proceed to the 'Low on Wigs!' quest.

0.0: Aaaaaack! My adorable wittle kitty-witty's in trouble! She's been so frustrated with her recent string of bad fur days that's she's clawed out all of her fur! My wittle Blondie won't be blonde anymore! WE HAVE TO FIX THAT!
0.1: A WIG! YES! Perfect! We'll cover her in a wig! #b#o9420529#s#k have heads full of fine gold tresses... Are you thinking what I'm thinking?

yes.0: Eliminate #b50 #o9420529#s#k and bring back #b50 #t4000467#s#k! Hurry! Blondie's so upset, she's hiding under the quilt in my bedroom!

no.0: I hope Blondie doesn't do anything drastic! If she does, it's your fault!

1.0: Oh, thank you, thank you, thank you! My little kitty isn't the same without golden hair.

yes.0: Now she'll leave the house again, I just know it.
